findings.description: ascend_stripe_events table is referenced for webhook idempotency but never created in startup migrations — all webhook events fail with 'relation does not exist'
handleInvoicePaid skips billing_reason='subscription_create' — solo plan users receive 0 AI hours for their entire first billing period until the first renewal invoice
POST /refresh does not carry forward gen claim — token revocation bypass if user calls lumora /refresh after ascend /revoke-all-sessions
Admin flag is env-only with no persistent DB role column — misconfigured deploy silently demotes all admins
PAID_PLAN_TYPES missing 'lifetime' — lifetime subscribers treated as free tier on paywall checks using this constant
PRICE_TO_PLAN references undefined STRIPE_PRICES.TEAM — team checkout priceId resolves to undefined, making team plan detection fragile
Stripe charge can succeed while ai_hour_topups INSERT fails — user billed but receives no hours; needs idempotency/retry
